patthana23.57:1.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na atītārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho atītārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.57:2.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na anāgatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho anāgatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.57:3.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na paccuppannārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho paccuppannārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nasanidassanattika naajjhattārammaṇattike sanidassanattika ajjhattārammaṇattikaṃ
